notes: FDA PLACEBO-MEDIAN CORRECTION (Ekterly): FDA-reviewed placebo median time to initial relief was NOT ESTIMABLE within 12h (95% CI 3.60-NE). The 6.72h figure is the sponsor publication's analysis; FDA kept attacks lacking two consecutive post-baseline assessments as unsuccessful through 12h instead of censoring at time zero (8 of 84 placebo attacks; 7 of 93 at 600mg). Earlier use of >12h vs 6.72h as evidence of a slow PHVS placebo arm was withdrawn.

Sebetralstat 600mg primary remained significant under FDA analysis (p=0.0004). Neither acute trial establishes superiority over the other; medians are not harmonized (population, rescue rules, assessment cadence, missingness).
Second study dose allowed from 4h (RAPIDe-3) vs 3h (KONFIDENT). Rescue within 12h counted as primary failure in RAPIDe-3; KONFIDENT counts rescue before relief event as failure.

Berotralstat 150mg (approved dose) used, not 110mg. CHAPTER-3 included 5 normal-C1-INH participants; APeX-2 type I/II only. Cross-trial ratio 0.305 is conditional arithmetic, not an approved sales-model efficacy input.
